Package com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc Description

Purpose of this package is keep implementation for DBCAPI.

This classes have a scope of private, packaged or protected. Also, some of the implementations are final. Some of these classes could be opened up for the clients in the future versions in order to allow clients to have their own implementation of resource manager.
